## Navimower Map Card 0.3.4-beta11

### Responsive scheduler editor
- Replace immediate per-button queue writes with a local draft, so repeat/remove/reorder interactions stay responsive and only `Save order` writes the complete queue.
- Debounce the queue save by 750 ms and show `Saving…` / `Saved` feedback while keeping unsaved edits local until the explicit save.
- Add touch-friendly pointer drag-and-drop with the drag handle on the right, plus automatic scrolling near the dialog edges for longer queues.
- Move the green repeat `+` and red remove `×` actions to the left of the zone name; the zone-name area remains passive so normal touch scrolling is not intercepted.
- Add `Add zone` from the scheduler's configured `selected_zone_ids`; only zones not currently represented in the draft are offered, and the control is disabled when every configured zone is present.
- A removed zone becomes available through `Add zone` again only after its final repeated occurrence is removed. The final remaining queue row cannot be removed.
- Render Navimower schedule start/end with Home Assistant's native Lovelace entity rows through `loadCardHelpers().createRowElement()`. Time changes therefore continue to save immediately and are intentionally independent from `Save order`.
- Make the dialog body scrollable with a sticky save footer, preserving mobile usability for long zone lists.
- Add regression coverage for configured-zone filtering, repeated zones, local-only edits, single backend save, device scoping, and empty-queue protection.
